summary: Website for "VS Appliances hub" offering services and spare parts for AC, washing machine, refrigerator, and electrical items, including customer service request registration, customer request tracking, and an admin-only dashboard to manage complaints, assign technicians, track spares used, and update request status (open/closed).

existing_features.title: Create a public marketing website for “VS Appliances Hub” that clearly communicates the business offers Services and Spares for the following categories: AC, Washing Machine, Refrigerator, and Electrical.

Add a category grid on the home page that displays an image card for each category (AC, Washing Machine, Refrigerator, Electrical). Each card must be clickable and route the user to a registration flow for either Service or Spares related to that category.

Implement customer registration/submission of a Service/Spares request: a form that captures at minimum category, request type (Service or Spares), customer name, phone number, address, problem/part description, and preferred visit/date (optional). Submit must create a request and show a success confirmation with a request reference/ID.
Add a “My Requests” page where signed-in customers can view a list of their submitted requests (showing request ID, category, type, status, and created date) and open a request detail view.

Define and apply one coherent visual theme across the site (colors, typography, spacing, and components) appropriate for a home-appliance repair/spares business, avoiding a blue/purple primary palette.

Add the generated category images and logo as static assets under `frontend/public/assets/generated` and render them in the UI (home category grid and site header/hero). Do not serve these images from the backend.
Add the user-uploaded VS logo to the app as a static asset and use it as the primary site logo (header and any existing logo placements), replacing the current generated logo reference.

Create a separate Admin page in the frontend that is only accessible to admins. The page must show registered complaints/requests, allow assigning a technician, recording spares used, and setting status to Open or Closed.

Update customer-facing request tracking UI to display the new request status (Open/Closed) and any admin-provided fields that are safe to show to customers (e.g., assigned technician and spares used if present).
Extend the Admin Dashboard page to support admin-friendly request triage tools: search, filtering, and sorting over the existing request list returned by the current admin API.
Add at-a-glance operational summary widgets to the Admin Dashboard using the already-fetched request list.
Improve request editing workflow in the Admin Dashboard to reduce clicks and make request details easier to review during updates.
Add an export capability for admins to download the currently visible (post-filter/search/sort) request list from the Admin Dashboard as a CSV file.
Fix admin update cache invalidation so that all relevant React Query caches refresh correctly after an admin updates a request.

new_feature_requests.summary: Create a business website for VS Appliances hub to offer services and spare parts for AC, washing machine, refrigerator, and electrical categories
Allow customers to register/submit a service request via the website
Show category images (AC, washing machine, refrigerator, electrical) that users can click to register for service or spares

Persist and expose service/spares requests in the Motoko backend actor with APIs to: create a request, fetch a request by ID, and list requests submitted by the currently authenticated user (Internet Identity).
Add and display the provided VS Appliances Hub logo in the site UI (e.g., header/hero)
Enable customers to track/view the status of their submitted requests (request tracking)
Create an admin-only page/dashboard to view registered complaints/requests, assign technicians, record spares used, and update request status (open/closed)

Extend the backend request data model to support admin workflow fields: request status (at minimum Open/Closed), assigned technician (free-text), spares used (free-text or a list), and created/updated timestamps.
Add backend admin APIs (admin-only) to support the admin dashboard: list all requests, and update a request’s status, assigned technician, and spares used.
Extend/improve admin tools beyond the current admin dashboard capabilities (additional admin workflows/features to be defined)
